title: Chilli Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 2 peppers (red, orange or yellow), deseeded and chopped
2 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and chopped
steps: Throw all vegetables into an extra-large roasting tin; add Italian seasoning, chilli flakes and balsamic vinegar; season; mix well. Spray generously with cooking spray; mix again.
Roast 25 minutes; stir; roast another 20 minutes until soft and starting to caramelise.
Check at 10-minute intervals if still underdone.
notes: Makes up to 5 days in fridge. Also great with mushrooms, butternut squash, garlic, celery, broccoli, green beans, parsnips or asparagus.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
